title: Evaluating Synthetic Data Generation Methods for Heart Disease Classification
summary: A Jupyter notebook study comparing seven synthetic-data generation techniques (bootstrapping, shuffling, SMOTE, and several deep generative models) for augmenting a heart disease dataset and re-training classifiers on the synthetic outputs. SDV's single-table API is run directly, fitting GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, building metadata with sdv.metadata.Metadata, and scoring outputs with sdv.evaluation.single_table's diagnostic and quality-report functions.
